dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: A new project has started, a momentous new toy awaits discovery — pre-orders available now! Do leave your feedback here, by the way. It is most valuable to us. — Leschots's Clockwork Workshop

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: Angry Message

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: "Another pre-order, another first-come-first-served trial model? Leschots's isn't half the shop it used to be. Get out before you get sucked in, everyone!"

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: Earnest Message

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: "A masterpiece. Seriously, there's nothing to nitpick here, no doubt about it. Seriously, I'm crying over here, thinking about how I'll play this all my life — y'know what I mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: Precise Message

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: "I have a friend working in the production of this one. This one has an internal code of 001, and its development was personally overseen by the boss. Easy pre-order. This is going to be amazing."

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: Hurried Message

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: "I have a friend working in the production of this one. This one has an internal code of 001, and its development was personally overseen by the boss. Easy pre-order. This is going to be amazing. (1 for 500 Mora)"

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: Excited Message

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: "Champion Duelists make for a great theme. I've never tried something like this before... but there had better be an outfit swap mechanic here, and a cool one, at that!"

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: Professional Message

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: "The design of this thing isn't much different from that of a normal adventurer toy. I cannot see any flair unique to a Champion Duelist in this."

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: "Furthermore, I do not understand what this 'agility honed through ten thousand underwater dashes' business is about. No Champion Duelist trains underwater in this way."

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: "This feels like a skin of another toy that lacks sincerity and soul. In sum, this is far from the equal of Lepaute Horlogerie next door."

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: Unexpected Message

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: "To be honest, I'm more interested in those penguins at the shop entrance. Please contact me, I have a collaboration in mind."

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: Cutely-Written Message

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: "This is the Melusine fairy. Everyone who sees this message will receive a Melusine for free~"

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: More...

dialogues.speaker: Champion Duelist Evaluation Column
dialogues.text: Leave
